title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to deliver comprehensive insights and streamline your workflow.

title: Enhanced File Control in Editor
summary: We've introduced a robust file management system within the editor, empowering you to easily upload, remove, download, and control how your files appear in your content.

title: Introducing the Noeko Product Roadmap
summary: Explore Noeko's journey with our new public roadmap, offering clear insights into recently delivered features, what's coming next, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Smarter, More Intuitive Checkboxes
summary: Effortlessly manage your tasks with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for a smoother experience across the platform.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a significantly upgraded collaboration in the editor, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient than ever before.

title: Effortless Shared Content Access
summary: Discovering and collaborating on shared content with your connections is now more streamlined and accessible than ever before.

title: Noeko Goes Multilingual
summary: Noeko will soon speak your language, enabling a truly global experience for all users.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko, empowering you with greater control, direct involvement in our project's growth, and complete transparency into our development.

title: Enhanced Constellation View: Intelligent Exploration
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity and control thanks to dynamic filtering capabilities by tags, time, and shared items in the revitalized Constellation view.

title: Unlock Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Discover and curate your most relevant information with powerful new filtering and sorting capabilities, allowing you to save and revisit personalized knowledge collections.

title: Dynamic Views for Your Connected Notes
summary: Effortlessly organize and interact with your connected ideas through new versatile display modes, helping you structure your thoughts in a way that perfectly suits your workflow.

title: Noeko: Take Control with Self-Hosting and Enhanced Plans
summary: Soon, you can self-host Noeko for complete control or explore new cloud-hosted plans with enhanced capabilities designed to grow with your needs.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Enhanced Customization
summary: We are enhancing our current themes to resolve existing issues and introducing a variety of exciting new themes to expand your personalization options.

title: Smart Time-Based Greetings
summary: Enjoy perfectly timed greetings that genuinely reflect the current moment, enhancing your personalized experience on our platform.

title: Streamlined Tag Actions
summary: Unleash powerful new bulk actions directly within your tag views, allowing you to manage and organize your tagged items with incredible speed and ease.

title: Expand Your Knowledge Sources
summary: We're dramatically expanding the types of content you can bring into the platform, including YouTube videos, websites, and various text formats, empowering you to consolidate all your essential information in one place.
